blocks.text: Ms. Mystic is a comic book superhero created by comic book artist/writers Neal Adams and Michael Netzer. The character's first full appearance was in Captain Victory and the Galactic Rangers #3, published by Pacific Comics. After Pacific published two issues, the character was published by Adams' own company Continuity Comics, for a total of nine issues between 1982 and 1994.

Mystic is a comic book from the Florida-based CrossGen Comics. It was created by writer Ron Marz and artist Brandon Peterson and was one of five flagship titles in the company's Sigilverse shared universe. Mystic ran for 43 issues.
